# Realistic Architecture Pass

## Production-path changes

1. Add a face-structure painter for ears, jaw, chin, philtrum, neck shadow, and asymmetry.
2. Add an anatomical torso painter for shoulder slope, ribcage, waist, pelvis, lapels, and fabric light.
3. Rewrite arm rendering around shoulder-elbow-wrist geometry.
4. Rewrite leg rendering around hip-knee-ankle geometry and planted feet.
5. Enrich garment rendering with sleeves, folds, hems, coat opening, and skirt/trouser separation.
6. Add a realistic office-object painter with material-specific construction.
7. Add a scene-object evaluator supporting static, slide, roll, fall, bounce, flash, steam, print, and spin actions.
8. Add a realistic office set with depth layers, window light, desk, shelves, clock, machine station, printer, plant, and floor perspective.
9. Add character-anchored speech bubbles with safe wrapping and tails.
10. Keep all additions inside the shared `CinematicFrameRenderer` path.

## Exact quality requirements

- At least 16 camera shots and 10 camera-size/angle combinations.
- At least 12 spoken lines with visible mouth movement.
- At least 20 distinct performance/action clips.
- At least 12 scene objects and 8 animated object actions.
- At least 8 character-anchored text bubbles plus title cards and lower-third text.
- Four scale courts and at least nine representative story frames.
- Final sixty-second H.264/AAC export and hashes.
